steps.instruction: Confirm the surface is dry to firm touch — a scumble drags wet paint into mud.
Mix the scumble slightly lighter and cooler than the passage under it; white-heavy mixes with a whisper of the local color work best.
Load the brush, then wipe most of it off on a rag. The right amount feels like too little.
Drag flat across the texture high points — atmosphere, mist, turning light on cloth and skin. The underlayer must stay visible through every stroke.
Stop before it reads as a solid layer. If you lose the underlayer, wipe back while wet and retry with less paint.
